posts.post:
What do I do about it?
I have a long history of depression and anxiety and until now I havent admitted that I went through some trauma in my childhood due to my bi polar mother and getting bullied at school. I’ve had nightmares my whole life related to her but I can barely remember all that happened. I only remember bits and pieces of my childhood. And nearly anything before I was 8 is just gone except for a trip to disney world and times I would hang out with my cousins. I don’t feel like I have a real mom, im not emotionally connected to her at all.   I went to a therapy intake and brought these things up and the therapist pre-diagnosed me with ptsd to be followed up with my assigned therapist. I never really thought of myself as having true ptsd before. How do I know how bad it really was if I can barely remember it? I guess my body is telling me it’s bad but sometimes I feel like I’m overreacting. I don’t even understand how I can get past it, how does processing trauma work? Especially if I can barely remember?   I feel like there’s this wall keeping me out of some deeper parts of myself.

Vegetarian sandwich ideas?
I love sandwiches, but I need more interesting ideas besides grilled cheese, or tofurkey and cheese.

Alone and scared, please help
I keep fucking things up. School, friends, jobs. I’m going nowhere no matter how hard I try. My depression and anxiety mess everything in my life up, they tear it to shreds until I have nothing left.  I try so hard to feel better. I don’t understand what’s wrong with me, why can’t I even do the simplest of things. I feel like im never gonna be able to succeed or have a life I feel good about. Why can’t I stop fucking up I’m scared of death but sometimes I wish it would just happen already

So numb
Tired. Dead. I need something to make me feel again. Something besides the endless anxiety and lethargy. I either feel really bad or nothing at all.  I have public speaking class in the morning and a speech I have to give. If I can get myself to do it, maybe I can believe in myself again. Somehow I doubt that.

People assume so many things
That I’m stupid for doing things considerably risky and dangerous. Listen, I know something could go very wrong. The thing is, I don’t fucking care. I just want to feel something, or die trying.   People try to be my friend, assuming I want one. That’s a safe assumption. It would be nice if I were able to have friends. But the nature of my behavior does not allow for it. I am impulsive, unpredictable, and I will disappoint you. So it’s better if I just don’t talk to you very much, and it’s better if I push you away. I’m doing it on purpose. You’ll get fucking hurt and it’ll be my fault.   If you’ve only known me for a few months, don’t assume you actually know me. There are things I’ve never told people I’ve known for years. Things my own family doesn’t know. Just because I try to be a nice person, because kindness is so lacking in this world, doesn’t mean I’m a good one.   If I had the capacity to fully change I would have done it by now.

Maybe I can go through with this
Now that the colder seasons have arrived, I am toying with the idea of hypothermia. It’s supposedly a pleasant way to go. You go unconscious before you die, and in the end you actually feel incredibly warm.   There’s a river nearby that I think will be a good spot. I like this plan because my family is unlikely to be the ones to find me, and it’s not messy at all. And like I said, it sounds nicer than most options.   Not sure when I’ll do it though.

Does anyone else repeat something they said in their head over and over?
Sometimes if I have a conversation with someone, I’ll repeat what was said in my head over and over again. Sometimes it frustrates me but I can’t make myself stop. Most of the the time I’ll repeat just what I said. I know some people with ASD do this out loud but I just do it in my head. Idk if my description makes sense but I was wondering if this is an ASD thing or something else.

Is it normal to get a headache?
Im having a bad derealization episode right now and it feels like my head is under a lot of pressure and it’s causing a headache. Is this normal? Things are also a little blurry. I feel like I should sleep through it but it’s hard for me to sleep

Being in a group of people is so triggering for me
I feel compelled to say something even though it makes me uncomfortable to talk in front of everybody. I just don’t understand the nuances of talking in groups. I have to go to one for therapy but I’m thinking of just dropping it because it triggers me so much and just continue with my individual therapy. Would that be bad to do? I feel like the negatives of this group outweigh the rewards.

Im begging for help
I feel like im stuck in a dark pit. A void. Nothing I see or do makes me feel anything. The only things i feel are anxiety, fatigue or sadness. My chest is constantly tight and sometimes i get palpitations if im anxious. I feel dizzy and lightheaded sometimes. I have no motivation to do much of anything. All i want to do is curl up in my blanket and cry.  I got out of the hospital two weeks ago because of my suicidal intent. Right now i am no longer suicidal, but i dont feel any relief. Everything is constant pain. It’s so hard for me to do the simplest of things. I dont know how im going to get out of this. I dont know what to do with myself
